title: The loop-nilpotent cohomological Hall algebra
summary: We give an explicit shuffle algebra model for the loop-nilpotent cohomological Hall algebra (CoHA) of a tripled quiver with canonical cubic potential. As consequences, we (1) relate the loop-nilpotent CoHA to the quantized Coulomb branch algebra of the corresponding quiver gauge theory, (2) show that the loop-nilpotent CoHA is supercommutative after specialization at $\hbar=0$, (3) give generators for both the loop-nilpotent CoHA and the full preprojective CoHA, and (4) obtain an explicit characterization of the BPS Lie algebra of the full preprojective CoHA via certain degree and…
